description: Presidential Secretariat - The Public Security Ordinance (Chapter 40) Amendment to the Gazette Extraordinary No. 2120/5 of April 22, 2019
reasoning: This gazette contains amendments to emergency regulations under the Public Security Ordinance, specifically modifying legal definitions, procedures, and prohibitions related to terrorism, telecommunications, facial coverings, and extremist ideologies. It constitutes legal/regulatory content as it involves modifications to existing regulations and establishes new legal provisions and compliance requirements.
